{{Quote|I wonder if someone like me really belongs in the Pioneer Association...}}

Fratellone is the eldest of the [[The Three Fratellis' Challenge|Fratellis Brothers]] and is training to build his courage to join the Pioneer Association with his brothers. Rover frequently saves him from his nightmares in Echo Challenge: Clear Cloud.

Each challenge rewards Union EXP x30, [[Astrite]] x20, [[Monnaie]] x40, and EXP Materials. Completing all his challenge will grant the quest [[The Bizarre Brothers: Fratellone]].

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Sleep talking while in a nightmare)
:{{DIcon}} Please, don't make me eat Baton Bread again! They're so dry and hard...
:{{DIcon}} Stop making me take baths, Lord Tubpup... My skin's wrinkled...
:{{DIcon}} Nooo... don't pick me to be the Blessed Maiden―I don't want to wear a dress!
:{{DIcon}} The Dark Tide! Fratellino, don't go skinny-dipping in the Dark Tide!
:{{DIcon}} Wait, I have to fight Lorelei? Are you serious...
:{{DIcon}} Boil the great dragon into soup? Spare me, please...
:{{DIcon}} Ugh... if we get surrounded by the Plushie Squad... each of us would have to fight 1.3 Plushies...
:{{DIcon}} I thought we were heading to the Pioneer Association, not boarding the Pilgrim's Sail!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==<!---Unsure if the location determines the dialogue or it follows by order of interaction--->
{{Dialogue Start}}
{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact|20}} (Absorb Nightmare Clouds in your surroundings)
:;(Optional - Talk to Fratellone)
:'''Fratellone:''' Ah...No! I can't fall asleep... Mmm...
:'''Rover:''' What's wrong?
:'''Fratellone:''' I wanted to capture a Nightmare Cloud for research, but I accidentally got hit... Quick, use that to help me...
:'''Fratellone:''' Go to those Nightmare Clouds... and then...
:'''Fratellone:''' Capture one... give it to me...
:'''Fratellone:''' Oh no... the nightmare's about to start...
:'''Fratellone:''' ...

{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact|20}} (Wake up Fratellone)
:'''Fratellone:''' Ugh, I think I had a really long nightmare.
:'''Rover:''' Are you okay? What are you doing here?
:'''Fratellone:''' Oh, hello! I'm Fratellone of the Fratellis. My two brothers and I are training to join the Pioneer Association.
:'''Fratellone:''' I was hoping to prove myself by catching a Nightmare Cloud, but I got attacked instead. Thank you for helping me!
:'''Fratellone:''' What exactly is the Nightmare Cloud?
:'''Fratellone:''' The elders say that Nightmare Clouds are formed by the murmurs of people lost in nightmares.
:'''Fratellone:''' They're filled with all the frightful thoughts that appears in people's minds while they sleep.
:'''Fratellone:''' I... I'm really nervous about joining the Pioneer Association. There are just so many unknowns ahead! But I'm also worried about my two younger brothers. That's why I need Nightmare Clouds to train my willpower!
:{{DIcon}}: The Pioneer Association isn't as dangerous as you think.
::'''Fratellone:''' No way! Going to strange places and eating unfamiliar food―I get stomach cramps just thinking about it!
:{{DIcon}}: You can do it, Fratellone!
::'''Fratellone:''' Thanks!
:'''Fratellone:''' See you later then!
:'''Fratellone:''' By the way, once my training is over, come visit me in Egla Town. I'll repay you properly!
----
{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact|20}} (Wake up Fratellone)
:'''Fratellone:''' Ah, it's you! Wait... does that mean I got attacked again?
:'''Fratellone:''' I wonder if someone like me really belongs in the Pioneer Association...
:{{DIcon}} You can do it, Fratellone!
:{{DIcon}} You can do it! You're already ahead of most people!
:'''Fratellone:''' If you say so... I'll give it another shot!
----
{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact|20}} (Wake up Fratellone)
:'''Fratellone:''' It feels like I'm getting used to being saved by you lately...
:'''Fratellone:''' ...
:'''Fratellone:''' You know, I think I dreamt through every single problem I might face after joining the Pioneer Association.
:'''Fratellone:''' It feels like I've already had enough.
:{{DIcon}} But you haven't even joined yet!
:{{DIcon}} Come on, Fratellone! You've got this!
:'''Fratellone:''' Alright, since you say so, I'll keep pushing forward!
----
{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact|20}} (Wake up Fratellone)
:'''Fratellone:''' Aaah... Good morning!
:'''Fratellone:''' Looks like you slept pretty well, huh?
:'''Fratellone:''' Yeah, seems like the Nightmare Clouds can't give me bad dreams anymore.
:'''Fratellone:''' Maybe I've already had all my nightmares?
:{{DIcon}} Way to go, Fratellone!
:{{DIcon}} Can you actually run out of nightmares?
:'''Fratellone:''' Haha, I'm heading back to Egla Town for a bit. Maybe we'll meet there! I still owe you a big thanks!
{{Dialogue End}}
